description: This file contains utility functions related to voice wake triggers and locale identifier normalization, likely used in a voice-activated application.

methods.name: sanitizeVoiceWakeTriggers
methods.description: Trims whitespace, filters empty words, limits the number of words, and truncates each to a maximum length. Returns default triggers if input is empty.

methods.name: normalizeLocaleIdentifier
methods.description: Removes user-specific, Unicode, and variant suffixes from locale identifier strings, normalizing them to a base locale.
